claims.claim: Suitable to store industrial liquids or hazardous chemicals
claims.evidence: Photos show cage/tank exterior only; no way to confirm chemical compatibility, prior contents, or bladder integrity from images.

risks.risk: Ambiguous embossed capacity ('1000' vs '250 LTR' partly obscured)
risks.proof: Clear unobstructed close-up of the full embossed capacity plate/number
risks.if_unproven: price at the smaller stated capacity (250L) as worst case

risks.risk: Unknown prior contents (food-grade vs chemical residue) affecting safety/reuse value
risks.proof: Photo of any manufacturer/content label or seller-provided usage history
risks.if_unproven: price as unknown/possibly contaminated, lowest reuse grade

risks.risk: Inner bladder condition (cracks, stains, odor, UV degradation)
risks.proof: Photo looking inside tank opening/lid and close-up of inner wall
risks.if_unproven: price as if bladder compromised (non-potable, leak risk)

risks.risk: Cage and pallet base rust/structural integrity
risks.proof: Full-frame photo of cage welds, base pallet, and any rust spots
Video or photo of valve being opened/closed with liquid flow test
risks.if_unproven: price as non-functional valve needing replacement

risks.risk: Number of units actually included in sale
risks.proof: Wide shot showing all units together with a count confirmation from seller
Photo of manufacture date stamp usually molded near the base

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the full capacity embossing without cage bar obstruction
Photo inside the tank opening showing bladder wall and any residue
Video of the valve being operated to show flow and seal condition
Wide shot of all units included in the sale with a count
Photo of manufacture date stamp near the base
Any label or paperwork indicating prior stored substance
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies the item as a caged IBC tote tank, so it can be priced at worst case given unresolved capacity, contents history, and condition risks.
